basis: Intellectual disability and degenerative retinal disease define the syndrome; both documented in 4/4 patients.
Sebaceous carcinoma arising in ocular adnexa, usually the eyelid; metastatic sites are not defining organs.
Lysosomal disease with defining neurodegeneration; dysostosis multiplex in 16/16. Hearing-loss frequency unspecified; hepatomegaly alone does not establish injury.
Inherited glomerular disease with proteinuria, nephrotic syndrome and progressive renal dysfunction.
Generalized epilepsy; mouth and eye movements during seizures do not establish gastrointestinal or ocular damage.
Carcinoma originating in the uterine body, a reproductive organ outside the axes.
Isolated sperm flagellar abnormalities and male infertility; no endocrine or other axis involvement established.
Acute metabolic syndrome defined by encephalopathy with cerebral edema, hepatic fatty degeneration and hypoglycemia.
Epileptic activity defines this umbrella; metabolic, immune and infectious causes apply only to particular subtypes.
Congenital sensorineural hearing loss; no additional neurologic disorder is established.
Abducens cranial neuropathy; strabismus reflects denervation rather than direct damage to ocular structures.
Developmental impairment and structural brain anomalies define disease; scoliosis in 2/5 (40%). Facial appearance and feeding difficulty alone do not establish other organ injury.
Umbrella of inborn energy-metabolism disorders; no additional damaged organ is established across most subtypes.
Disease located in renal tubules; metabolic abnormalities are not universal across this heterogeneous group.
Immune inflammatory infiltration of pancreatic endocrine islets; exocrine pancreatic damage is not established.
Sarcoma originates in the uterine corpus; uterine smooth muscle is outside the skeletal musculoskeletal axis.
The disease definition explicitly encompasses cardiomyopathy, arrhythmias and skeletal muscle weakness or atrophy.
Skeletal dysplasia affecting vertebrae and metaphyses; extra-skeletal findings are subtype-specific.
Progressive skeletal myopathy; palpitations alone do not establish cardiac injury, and elevated AST can originate from muscle.
Metatarsal osteochondrosis with structural bone and joint destruction; no systemic vascular or immune disease is established.
Defining lead neurotoxicity; direct vascular toxicity with hypertension in 30-79%. Renal dysfunction and anemia occur in 5-29%; GI symptoms alone do not establish damage.
Congenital erythroid marrow failure; specific skeletal, cardiac and renal malformations are each occasional (5-29%); iron overload is treatment-related.
Intra-abdominal chemodectomas are paraganglionic neuroendocrine tumors; cutaneous angiolipomas define the accompanying skin involvement.
Inherited hemoglobin synthesis disorder; bone changes and organ iron overload concern severe forms or treatment, not most patients across the umbrella.
Carcinoma originates in the lung hilum; no additional commonly damaged organ is established.
